512         if (HPDcacheCfg.u.mshrWays > 1) begin : gen_mshr_ack_way_gt_1
513             assign mshr_ack_way = refill_fifo_resp_meta_rdata.r_id[HPDcacheCfg.mshrSetWidth +:
514                                                                    HPDcacheCfg.mshrWayWidth];
515         end else begin : gen_mshr_ack_way_eq_1
516             assign mshr_ack_way = '0;
517         end
518     end else begin : gen_mshr_set_eq_1
519         //  MSHR ack set and way
520         assign mshr_ack_set = '0;
521         if (HPDcacheCfg.u.mshrWays > 1) begin : gen_mshr_ack_way_gt_1
522             assign mshr_ack_way = refill_fifo_resp_meta_rdata.r_id[0 +: HPDcacheCfg.mshrWayWidth];
523         end else begin : gen_mshr_ack_way_eq_1
524             assign mshr_ack_way = '0;
525         end
526     end
527 
528     //  Write the new entry in the cache directory
529     //  In case of error in the refill response, invalidate pre-allocated cache directory entry
530     assign refill_dir_entry_o = '{
531         valid   : ~refill_is_error_o,
532         wback   : ~refill_is_error_o & refill_wback_q,
533         dirty   : 1'b0,
534         fetch   : 1'b0,
535         tag     : refill_tag_q,
536         default :'0
537     };
538 
539     assign refill_core_rsp.rdata   = refill_core_rsp_rdata;
540     assign refill_core_rsp.sid     = refill_core_rsp_sid;
541     assign refill_core_rsp.tid     = refill_core_rsp_tid;
542     assign refill_core_rsp.error   = refill_core_rsp_error;
543     assign refill_core_rsp.aborted = 1'b0;
544 
545     hpdcache_fifo_reg #(
546         .FIFO_DEPTH  (1),
547         .FEEDTHROUGH (HPDcacheCfg.u.refillCoreRspFeedthrough),
548         .fifo_data_t (hpdcache_rsp_t)
549     ) i_refill_core_rsp_buf(
550         .clk_i,
551         .rst_ni,
552         .w_i         (refill_core_rsp_valid),
553         .wok_o       (/*unused*/),
554         .wdata_i     (refill_core_rsp),
555         .r_i         (1'b1),  //  core shall always be ready to consume a response
556         .rok_o       (refill_core_rsp_valid_o),
557         .rdata_o     (refill_core_rsp_o)
558     );
559 
560     //  refill's width is bigger than the width of the core's interface
561     if (REFILL_REQ_RATIO > 1) begin : gen_core_rsp_data_mux
562         hpdcache_mux #(
563             .NINPUT      (REFILL_REQ_RATIO),
564             .DATA_WIDTH  (HPDcacheCfg.reqDataWidth)
565         ) data_read_rsp_mux_i(
566             .data_i      (refill_data_o),
567             .sel_i       (refill_core_rsp_word[0 +: $clog2(REFILL_REQ_RATIO)]),
568             .data_o      (refill_core_rsp_rdata)
569         );
570     end
571 
572     //  refill's width is equal to the width of the core's interface
573     else begin : gen_core_rsp_eqsize
574         assign refill_core_rsp_rdata = refill_data_o;
575     end
576 
577     /* FIXME: when multiple chunks, in case of error, the error bit is not
578      *        necessarily set on all chunks */
579     assign refill_fifo_resp_meta_wdata = '{
580         r_error    : mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_error,
581         r_id       : mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_id,
582         is_inval   : mem_resp_inval_i,
583         inval_nline: mem_resp_inval_nline_i
584     };
585 
586     hpdcache_fifo_reg #(
587         .FIFO_DEPTH  (HPDcacheCfg.u.refillFifoDepth),
588         .fifo_data_t (mem_resp_metadata_t)
589     ) i_r_metadata_fifo (
590         .clk_i,
591         .rst_ni,
592 
593         .w_i    (refill_fifo_resp_meta_w),
594         .wok_o  (refill_fifo_resp_meta_wok),
595         .wdata_i(refill_fifo_resp_meta_wdata),
596 
597         .r_i    (refill_fifo_resp_meta_r),
598         .rok_o  (refill_fifo_resp_meta_rok),
599         .rdata_o(refill_fifo_resp_meta_rdata)
600     );
601 
602     hpdcache_data_resize #(
603         .WR_WIDTH (HPDcacheCfg.u.memDataWidth),
604         .RD_WIDTH (HPDcacheCfg.accessWidth),
605         .DEPTH    (HPDcacheCfg.u.refillFifoDepth)
606     ) i_data_resize(
607         .clk_i,
608         .rst_ni,
609 
610         .w_i    (refill_fifo_resp_data_w),
611         .wok_o  (refill_fifo_resp_data_wok),
612         .wdata_i(mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_data),
613         .wlast_i(mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_last),
614 
615         .r_i    (refill_fifo_resp_data_r),
616         .rok_o  (/* unused */),
617         .rdata_o(refill_fifo_resp_data_rdata),
618         .rlast_o(/* unused */)
619     );
620 
621     assign refill_data_o = refill_fifo_resp_data_rdata;
622 
623     //      The DATA fifo is only used for refill responses
624     assign refill_fifo_resp_data_w = mem_resp_valid_i &
625             ((refill_fifo_resp_meta_wok | ~mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_last) &
626             ~mem_resp_inval_i);
627 
628     //      The METADATA fifo is used for both refill responses and invalidations
629     assign refill_fifo_resp_meta_w = mem_resp_valid_i &
630             ((refill_fifo_resp_data_wok & mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_last) |
631             mem_resp_inval_i);
632 
633     always_comb
634     begin : mem_resp_ready_comb
635         mem_resp_ready_o = 1'b0;
636         if (mem_resp_valid_i) begin
637             if (mem_resp_inval_i) begin
638                 mem_resp_ready_o = refill_fifo_resp_meta_wok;
639             end else begin
640                 mem_resp_ready_o = (refill_fifo_resp_meta_wok | ~mem_resp_i.mem_resp_r_last) &
641                                     refill_fifo_resp_data_wok;
642             end
643         end
644     end
645 
646     always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni)
647     begin : miss_resp_fsm_ff
648         if (!rst_ni) begin
649             refill_fsm_q <= REFILL_IDLE;
650         end else begin
651             refill_fsm_q <= refill_fsm_d;
652         end
653     end
654 
655     always_ff @(posedge clk_i)
656     begin : miss_resp_fsm_internal_ff
657         if ((refill_fsm_q == REFILL_WRITE) && (refill_cnt_q == 0)) begin
658             refill_set_q <= mshr_ack_cache_set;
659             refill_way_q <= mshr_ack_cache_way;
660             refill_tag_q <= mshr_ack_cache_tag;
661             refill_sid_q <= mshr_ack_src_id;
662             refill_tid_q <= mshr_ack_req_id;
663             refill_need_rsp_q <= mshr_ack_need_rsp;
664             refill_is_prefetch_q <= mshr_ack_is_prefetch;
665             refill_wback_q <= mshr_ack_wback;
666             refill_core_rsp_word_q <= mshr_ack_word;
667         end
668         refill_cnt_q <= refill_cnt_d;
669     end
